Both environments share the same plugin Host/client functionality; environment-specific installat"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ion notes are documented below."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 1 Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 1.1 Session lifecycle management"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Delete** is irreversible and always asks for confirmation. Subagent sessions and transient blank"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" placeholders (no persisted artifact) cannot be deleted.
- **Archive / Unarchive** moves a session i"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n and out of the active list without touching its disk content.
- **Move to workspace** keeps histor"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"y, title, archive state and derived-session relationships intact, rewrites the session's `cwd` to th"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"e target workspace, synchronizes the runtime `workingDirectory` projection for active agents, and up"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"dates the live writer's header in place so any pending tool calls keep landing on the new path. When"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" the session's `cwd` already equals the target workspace path but its membership was never recorded,"},{"id":"p9s8","text":" only the missing membership is repaired: no `cwd` rewrite, no artifact rewrite or move, and no sess"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"ion restart.
- **Migrate Agent preset** rewrites the latest `agent-preset/selected` event (or the se"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"ssion header if no such event exists) so a session whose preset was renamed or removed can resume. M"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"essage history is never altered."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 1.2 Session shortcuts"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Favorites / Review-later** are manual flags that survive archive and session end; neither is cle"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ared automatically.
- **Search** matches title, session ID, note and tags case-insensitively, trims "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"whitespace, and never reads chat history.
- **Filters and sorting** combine a workspace selector (Al"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"l / Ungrouped / specific) with an archive filter (All / Active / Archived), then layer favorites / r"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"eview, tag and priority filters on top. Sort by recently updated (default), least recently updated, "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"newest created, oldest created, name ascending (A-Z), name descending (Z-A), or **priority (1 → 5)**"},{"id":"p11s7","text":".
- **Priority** is a dropdown **1 Highest, 2 High, 3 Normal, 4 Low, 5 Lowest**, default **3 (Normal"},{"id":"p11s8","text":")**; legacy `null` priorities are normalized to 3.
- **Tags / Notes**: up to 20 tags per session (≤ "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"32 characters each) and a 2000-character note. Both English `,` and Chinese `，` are separators, whit"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"espace is trimmed, duplicate tags are merged case-insensitively.
- **AI-assisted tagging** is manual"},{"id":"p11s11","text":" and opt-in: **Copy Prompt** writes a structured prompt (Chinese or English, matched to the active U"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"I) to the clipboard; **Import** parses the clipboard JSON (tolerating Markdown fences, conversationa"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"l wrappers, smart quotes, stray backslashes and a leading BOM), validates it against the same limits"},{"id":"p11s14","text":", and populates the editor fields. Neither button calls a model automatically.
- Annotations live in"},{"id":"p11s15","text":" plain text under the DSH home (`dsh-session-manager/annotations.v1.json`), keyed by session ID. Sam"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"e-origin client instances stay in sync via `BroadcastChannel`. Saves are durable across crashes; rev"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"ision conflicts surface a "load latest" prompt."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 1.3 Bulk management"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Batch process mode**: click the toggle in the panel header to reveal row checkboxes, a **Select "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"all in filter / Clear selection** toolbar pair, and the bulk action bar. Exiting batch process clear"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s the current selection.
- **Action bar** lists every batch action:
- **Annotation toggles**: **Arch"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ive / Unarchive / Favorite / Unfavorite / Mark for review / Clear review flag**.
- **Mutating action"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"s**: **Add tags / Clear tags / Set priority / Move to workspace / Migrate preset / Delete session**."},{"id":"p13s6","text":"
- **Confirmation flow**:
- Non-destructive actions (archive / unarchive / favorite / unfavorite / r"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"eview / unreview / add-tags / clear-tags / set-priority / move / preset-migrate) fire immediately an"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"d report per-session results in a **result dialog** with **Success / Failed / Skipped** groups and a"},{"id":"p13s9","text":" one-click **Retry failed** that re-arms the failed IDs into the selection.
- Destructive actions (*"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"*delete session**) first open a **preview dialog** listing the targeted sessions, then show a progre"},{"id":"p13s11","text":"ss bar, then a per-id result dialog."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 1.4 Plugin updates and settings"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 5 Compatibility"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The table below lists verified version combinations between DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and `dsh-session-"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" below lists verified version combinations between DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and `dsh-session-manager`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> **Verification note**: From version 0.6.3 onwards, this plugin is verified with the official DSH D"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"esktop client only (the Web UI shares the same Host/client codebase but is no longer covered by the "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"verification matrix)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| DeepSeek Harness (DSH) | dsh-session-manager | Verified Environment |
